evidence.reason: At the pinned tip the compare lookup already resolves the base from origin. Lines 1084-1088 read `githubCompareBase(repoRoot, `refs/remotes/origin/${assembly.base}`)` rather than the bare `assembly.base` the finding describes, so the local-ref resolution/laggy-SHA defect no longer exists. History shows commit bb6e5cef4d5d7456c1039755668562ddc89c2883 ("fix(fix-run): Adopt writer identities, owner-only report, remote compare base") introduced the origin-ref form.
